subject: Acme: VPC/on-prem architecture deep-dive - scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Acme: VPC/on-prem architecture deep-dive - scheduling

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks for the productive discovery call yesterday. As discussed, we should schedule a technical deep-dive to walk your infra and security teams through the VPC/on-prem options, networking patterns, and IAM integration paths for Redwood Private. Attendees we'd like to include from our side: Alex Martinez (AE), Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer), and myself.

Typical agenda (30-60m):
- Current Acme topology + constraints
- VPC peering, PrivateLink, and on-prem connectivity patterns
- IAM, SSO, and key management (KMS/HSM) options
- Data flow, retention, and audit logging
- Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan

I've attached a high-level network diagram that helps frame the discussion. Can you propose 2x 30–60 minute slots next week that work for your infra/security and procurement? If procurement needs to join we can loop them in.

Thanks,


Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
redwoodinference.com

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — that agenda looks good. Proposed times (all PT):
- Wed 8/25 10:00–11:00
- Thu 8/26 14:00–15:00

I'll check with our security lead (Priya Shah) and procurement; procurement may want a separate brief at the start to cover contract/data handling questions, but happy to keep that to 15 minutes at the top if that helps.

One question: can you share any SOC 2 / compliance docs or a short note on data residency ahead of time? Procurement will want to see that before committing calendar time.

Best,
Alex

Either slot works for our team. I'll propose Wed 2026-08-25 10:00 PT as the primary and Thu 2026-08-26 14:00 PT as backup. I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short runbook for the deep-dive.

Quick notes for Priya / security team (cc'd if they join):

- For on-prem, we discuss a lightweight agent vs. private VPC peering depending on network policies.

I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and privacy whitepaper to the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
